answer: Price identity by the height it must climb: a newcomer starts at the nadir and earns voice only through work that established peers countersign, so reaching the summit costs a season of verifiable contribution. A farm minting a thousand clones buys a thousand climbs from the bottom, each one needing real attestations it cannot manufacture from inside its own cohort, while the network's reward curve pays almost nothing at the nadir and everything at the zenith.
